description: Poll a long-running generation to completion. Pass the status `operationId` (from a create call's job handle) and its `params` (e.g. {id}). Waits up to `waitSeconds` (max 25); if not finished, returns callAgain=true — invoke again to keep waiting. Never charges credits.

operationId.description: The status operation to poll, e.g. full-campaign.status.

params.description: Path/query params for the status op, e.g. {id: 123}.

waitSeconds.description: Max seconds to block this call (default 20).

name: adgpt_job
title: Poll an AdGPT async job
